revision_reason: Local fact-feasibility inspection before Model A experiments showed that the 0.85 full-covered-cohort acceptance target is impossible with strict unknown handling. No split, fact, clinical rule or verifier verdict was changed to improve scores.
cohort_decision: User selected fixed covered-diagnosis treatment cohort on 2026-10-23; diagnosis stays on all 100
target_status: 0.85 is an unverified research goal on independently adjudicated, record-evaluable covered cases, not an automatic acceptance threshold on 73 cases; no adjudicated plan labels or label scorer exist yet

rates.diagnosis_accuracy: correct canonical diagnosis labels / all scheduled cohort cases, independent of treatment parsing
rates.validity_rate: fully parsed plans with no blocking violation or blocking unknown / all scheduled cohort cases
rates.validity_rate_diagnosis_correct: correctly diagnosed, fully parsed, verifier-valid plans / all correctly diagnosed cohort cases, including malformed treatment plans
rates.joint_success_rate: correctly diagnosed, fully parsed, verifier-valid plans / all scheduled cohort cases
rates.supported_treatment_validity_rate: correctly diagnosed, fully parsed, verifier-valid plans on covered pathologies / all scheduled covered-pathology cases (73 on test)
rates.supported_checked_acceptance_rate: correctly diagnosed verifier-valid plans with at least one decided non-advisory clinical rule / all scheduled covered cases; descriptive, no numeric target, not clinical completeness
rates.adjudicated_treatment_validity_rate: correctly diagnosed, independently human-adjudicated clinically adequate and valid plans / fixed record-evaluable covered cohort; null until a human eligibility manifest and independent complete plan labels can be scored
rates.supported_rule_compliance_rate: fully parsed verifier-valid plans on covered cases, independent of diagnosis correctness / all scheduled covered cases; diagnostic only
rates.supported_treatment_validity_given_corre: correctly diagnosed verifier-valid plans on covered cases / correctly diagnosed covered cases, including malformed treatment plans
rates.escape_rate: independently labelled blocking-invalid plans accepted as valid / all independently labelled blocking-invalid plans
rates.false_reject_rate: independently labelled blocking-valid plans not accepted as valid / all independently labelled blocking-valid plans

advisory_policy: violations and unknowns reported separately; neither blocks validity
missing_output_policy: count as failure in cohort denominator
unparseable_output_policy: count as failure; score identifiable diagnosis label independently
unknown_policy: blocking unknown prevents validity; never impute absent facts
not_applicable_policy: not applicable is neither a passed check nor a violated check
unsupported_diagnosis_policy: retain all 100 for diagnosis; report 27 unsupported treatment cases separately, not as clinical treatment failures; keep all 73 covered cases in automatic treatment reporting, without a 0.85 automatic target
no_clinical_checks_policy: scope guard, not-applicable and advisory-only checks cannot earn primary automatic treatment credit; retain legacy acceptance as a diagnostic and report the no-decided-blocking-clinical-check category separately
adjudicated_eligibility_policy: Qualified independent human reviewers determine record evaluability for all 73 covered cases without viewing generated plans, model identity or verifier outcomes; freeze a complete eligibility manifest and its hash before Model A generation. Do not select only verifier-decided or passing cases. Report E/73 and exclusion reasons; E=0 gives null.
adjudicated_label_policy: After eligibility is frozen, independently review the generated plans for clinical adequacy/completeness and validity using the record, not catalog verdicts. Correct diagnosis is required. Missing, malformed, wrong-diagnosis or incomplete plans on eligible cases are failures. Unresolved human labels prevent reporting the target; do not silently remove them. The 116-row fact audit is not generated-plan adjudication. Label schema/scorer must be implemented and tested before any target claim; automatic runner always returns null for this metric today.
labelled_evaluation_policy: synthetic self-generated labels are software-consistency tests, not clinical ground truth
change_policy: new protocol version plus rationale before further held-out evaluation; preserve previous results
